answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Installed scaffolder registration with scaffolders association attestation. It requires a registration the association renews after assessed erections, so the crystal of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the walnut first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The grove is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
